title: Game jam idea
author: Brewgazer
selftext:
So I had an idea today, I have a discord I run to act as a library of knowledge and resources for ai game dev, I was thinking about hosting a game jam but it wouldn’t be a typical game jam. 

I use to be a fan of these live streams called vs where a group of people choose songs and the chat picks the best ones and they move onto the next round and pick new songs to vs until one wins. 

What if there was a game jam that got live-streamed and a YouTube video made out of it where we take a group of ai game devs, give them 10 minutes to come up with an idea/starting prompt, and after those 10 minutes each person gets 2 prompts, the one they should have been building while fleshing the idea out and one to fix any noticeable errors before showing the outcome. The chat decides who’s voted out and the remaining go on. Last three get 30 minutes to get the game where need to after 1 prompt. 

If this sounds like something you’d be interested in lmk. It wouldn’t be for a prize getting started maybe if it turns into something big or streams and videos do good numbers I can start throwing in prizes.

replies.author: Brewgazer
replies.body: If enough people are down, people gotta be cool with just watching and ranking, some gotta be cool with being a judge, someone’s gotta watch screen shares to make sure no one’s hiding prompts when it should be limited, a commentator or two(it could be kinda funny) it’ll take kinda building a community with this idea and doing it like once a month improving it every time
